mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO collection_notes (collection_id, note_id) VALUES (#{collectionId}, #{noteId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM collection_notes WHERE collection_id = #{collectionId} AND note_id = #{noteId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_notes cn JOIN collections c ON cn.collection_id = c.collection_id WHERE c.creator_id = #{creatorId} AND cn.note_id = #{noteId}
